changelog:
ClawRAG Connector 1.2.0 – Initial ClawHub release.

- Adds OpenClaw connector skill for local, privacy-first RAG infrastructure.
- Integrates MCP server support via @clawrag/mcp-server.
- Supports Docker-based deployment.
- Enables hybrid search (semantic + BM25) and smart ingestion of common document formats.
summary: Self-hosted RAG engine with hybrid semantic and keyword search, document ingestion, local privacy, and seamless OpenClaw integration via Docker.
